WANG Yi，HE Xue-mei，LIN Ping( Inner Mongolia Mental Health Center，Huhehot，010010)【Abstract 】 Objective: To estimate the incidence and influencing factors of interacting point medication and potential drug study on hospitalized patients with mental disorders． Methods: The information about medicine use among 388cases hospitalized patients with mental disorder on January 10th，2015 in Inner Mongolia Mental Health Center was collected statistically． Inquiry list of pharmacokinetic interaction was made based on Martindale drugs，and the potential condition of drug interaction was analyzed． Results: The proportion of 187 men and 201 women in 388 inpatients with mental disorder were 48． 20% and 51． 80% ，respectively． The average of inpatients age which ranges from 16 to 91 was 46． 40 ± 15． 51． At least 18． 04% of 388 cases hospitalized patients with mental disorder were detected to have one kind of potential pharmacokinetic interaction． There was positive correlation between the quantities of medicine taken together and detection rate of potential pharmacokinetic interaction( r = 0． 313，P ﹤ 0． 001) ． It was found that the drug used differed widely in the risk of pharmacokinetic interaction after the calculation of the frequency of the drug interaction． Conclusion: The detection rate of point medication potential pharmacokinetic interaction of hospitalized patients in Inner Mongolia Mental Health Center was 18． 04% ． The quantities and the species of medicine taken together were important factors which could have effect on the incidence of pharmacokinetic interaction．药物相互作用导致的不良反应增多和治疗失败，已经成为一种重要的医源性并发症［1］。
